Condition : 1 - INFORMATIVE

Regarding condition 6, this approval is subject to further information being submitted for the repair of the roof lights and staircase in House 5.

The following additional information should be provided:

1.	A detailed elevation (scale 1:20) of the staircase and timber wall partition.
2.	A detailed plan and section (scale 1:20) of the proposed rooflights showing how the insertion will have an effect on the existing metal ceiling tiles.

Regarding condition 7, this approval is subject to further information being submitted.

The following additional information should be provided:

3.	A detailed section of the proposed window WF in House 4.
description: Following approval for conversion and alterations of existing building into offices and two 1 bedroom houses, one 2 bedroom houses, demolition of existing single storey changing block and construction one bedroom houses, alterations and refurbishment of existing residential unit and associated parking - details submitted pursuant to condition 5 (plaques), 6 (schedule of repairs) and 7 (doors and windows schedule) of permission ref 00279/D/L1 dated 23/10/2001
